title: AI-written press releases

industry.rule: industry read from words in the issuer's name (for example 'Therapeutics', 'Bank', 'Mining'); first match wins

words.rule: known chatbot words only; measurable with 20+ uses before 30 Nov 2022 over 10+ clusters; rose = 95% cluster-bootstrap range of the after/before ratio above 1; the multiplier is shown only when that range's ends are within a factor of 2

limits: Funding, award and executive-hire releases: too few before {cutoff} to stand alone.
Industry is read from the issuer's name, so most releases are not placed in one; only technology and health reach the bar.
No issuer is shown: most send too few releases for a share that holds up.
Quotes are scored apart from release bodies; every other figure counts one body per release.
